name: Hyuuga Kon
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Sapphire of the 'Jewel Five'.
1st year high school student, Alchemy course.

A cool and logical blue alchemist. A pragmatist.
A clear headed guy who has top grades at the academy.
He thinks everything in nature can be understood with numerical formulas, a bit of an eccentric who will start doing calculations out of nowhere.
Part of the science club.
